place: Thonglor Road, Sukhumvit 55, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok, Thailand
title: The Strand Thonglor — Two-Bedroom 20th-Floor Residence
blurb: A two-bedroom residence on the 20th floor of The Strand Thonglor, the ultra-luxury tower at the mouth of Soi Thonglor, a one-minute walk from the BTS. 90 m² with 3-metre ceilings and floor-to-ceiling glass, plus a 27th-floor and rooftop clubhouse with pool, gym and putting green. Currently let at ฿135,000 a month. Freehold under the foreign quota. ฿34,000,000.
detail:
This 90 m² residence sits on the 20th floor of The Strand Thonglor, with two bedrooms, two bathrooms and an open living-kitchen space opening to city views through floor-to-ceiling glass. Ceilings rise to three metres, the kitchen is fully fitted with built-in appliances, and the apartment is wired for the building's app-linked home-automation and concierge system.

The Strand stands at the front of Soi Thonglor, with its own private residents' entrance and a one-minute, 150-metre walk to Thonglor BTS and road access from both Sukhumvit 55 and 57 — the heart of Bangkok's most cosmopolitan dining and nightlife district. Completed in 2021 by Eden Estate in partnership with MQDC, the 30-storey glass tower holds just 188 freehold residences and was designed by HB Design with interiors by PIA and landscaping by TROP.

Facilities span a 27th-floor and rooftop clubhouse — infinity pool and children's pool, fitness and meditation studio, sauna, putting green and a rooftop terrace — along with a residents' living room, business lounge, playroom, ground-level Strand Park and automated parking for 204 cars with EV charging.

The residence is currently tenanted at ฿135,000 per month, a gross yield of roughly 4.8%, and comes with a 30-year structural warranty. It is available freehold under the foreign-ownership quota. Lease terms, floor plan and title details are available on request.
